label: Web (Phaser 4 + TypeScript + Vite)
summary: Browser games: Phaser 4, TypeScript, Vite dev server and build, Vitest unit tests, Playwright headless smoke
setup_step: python tools/dev.py setup        # npm install + the headless browser smoke uses (versions are pinned in package.json)

adopt_hints.package.json: merge the scripts and devDependencies from package.json.gold into yours (vite, vitest, typescript, playwright), then run python tools/dev.py setup. Your game must log BOOT_OK to the console once the first scene is up (see docs/ENGINE_FLOW.md > Adopting an existing project).
adopt_hints.index.html: keep yours; it must load the module entry (src/main.ts) the way index.html.gold does.
